tasks.label: venv: setup

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path .venv)) { py -3.12 -m venv .venv }; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu; .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.command: [ -d .venv ] || python3 -m venv .venv;.venv/bin/python -m pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
